messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: service=orchestration-proxy, version=v1.9.3, env=prod, window=2026-04-05T22:00Z. HOLD applied due to incident INC-2026-04-05 affecting control-plane DB. Please confirm.

Maya: Ack. Putting the rollout on hold. We shouldn't trigger any leader re-election or rolling restarts until control plane is stable.

CJ: ops-oncall, can you confirm whether the incident impacts leader leases or is limited to read-replicas? The proxy touches leadership heartbeats.

ops-oncall: Root problem is a storage tier mismatch causing leader lease timeouts in us-central-1. Symptoms: frequent leadership churn, 503s to management endpoints. Proxy change adds aggressive heartbeat which could worsen churn.

Simon: If heartbeats are the risk, we must avoid pushing the new heartbeat behavior. Options: 1) disable new heartbeat flag via config, 2) patch and restart a small canary in non-impacted region, 3) full rollback to v1.9.2.

Lina: We have a runtime gate for the heartbeat, but it requires a config toggle exposed in the control plane. Ops, can you toggle it without restarts? If yes, that's the least invasive.

ops-oncall: Control-plane gate is reachable; we can flip it for canaries. However, toggling in-place for the entire fleet might be risky until DB is fixed. Recommend canary-only toggle in us-west-2.

Release Manager: Plan: 1) flip heartbeat flag off for canary nodes in us-west-2 -> 20m smoke -> if stable, resume limited canary to 5% (exclude us-central-1) at 2026-04-05T23:30Z UTC -> if unstable, schedule full deploy to 2026-04-06T02:00Z UTC after infra maintenance. I'll update release notes and notify Dedicated customers.

Maya: Add to release notes: "HOLD: v1.9.3 paused due to INC-2026-04-05; heartbeat feature gated for canaries while control-plane instability investigated." Also flag customers with strict SLAs for manual outreach.

deploy-bot: Action queued: toggle-flag=heartbeat=false -> target=proxy-canary-uswest2-01..04. Will post status when complete.

ops-oncall: Flag toggled on canaries. No restarts required. Monitoring: leadership churn reduced in canaries, error budget stable. :white_check_mark: 

Simon: OK to extend canary to 5% (skip us-central-1) for 45m. If green, we target a limited resumed rollout in the reduced window. If any degradation, we'll abort and pin traffic back to v1.9.2 for affected customers.

Lina: Also opening a follow-up ticket to add a non-startup feature-gate for heartbeat so we can avoid restarts in future.

Release Manager: New tentative slot set: 1865208600 (2026-04-05T23:30:00Z UTC). Final go/no-go after canary.

CJ: I'll coordinate partner comms and ensure Dedicated customers are pinned where needed.

Maya: Holding until canary verdict. Postmortem link will be posted to #incidents after RCA. Ping to reopen thread if anything changes.

deploy-bot: Status update: HOLD persists. Next_check=2026-04-05T22:30Z. Thread locked for action items. :lock:
